tiers.req: Hourglass started in Act 3 and every generator before Liquid Glass at level 50.
Liquid Glass, Limestone Mass, Pristine Glass, Cromlech Bricks and Condensed Vortex at level 100.
Hourglass level 2: every upgrade in the first upgrade row maxed.
Hourglass level 3 (Timeline open) and the first timeline reset done.
Hourglass level 7: Echo, Dragons, Rebirth and Secret Knowledge open, and with them Restoration of Eternity (three more tabs, 15 new generators, new rifts and gem-shop items; added in 0.320.0).
Upgrade row 11 reached (needs the Golden Claw generator).
Golden dragon bought (1.2e10 Echoes): it strengthens the Red, Blue and Green dragons. Optional: no stage expects it yet.
Rebirth running: its items merged up and its 5x5 grid opened past the first 3x3 with Eternity tree cells. Optional: no stage expects it yet.

tables.title: Hourglass rules
rows: Sand is made by the generators and pays for generator levels, upgrades and Hourglass levels. Infinity is earned by a timeline reset, once the Timeline opens at Hourglass level 3, and pays for timeline upgrades.
Each newer generator makes the older ones obsolete; put sand into the latest. Generator speed doubles at levels 25, 50, 100, 200, 300 and so on.

Sandstone Sample, Glass Sample, Water Sample, Clay Block, Bit of Knowledge, Liquid Glass, Limestone Mass, Pristine Glass, Cromlech Bricks, Condensed Vortex, Sol Essence, Locked Orery, Golden Bit (spelling to check in game), Golden Scales, Golden Claw. Restoration of Eternity adds 15 from level 7: Golden Horn, Golden Fang, Final Grain, Red Star Teseract (spelling to check in game), Golden Scarab, Ruby Eyeris (spelling to check in game), Prismatic Beacon, Unstable Element, Warped Geomentry (spelling to check in game), Unleashed Formula, Attraction Anchor, Arcane Carapace, Trypa Sphere (spelling to check in game), Bothsides Amulet (spelling to check in game), Follpwer Insignia (spelling to check in game). The Unstable Element's first purchase costs about E143 sand and out-produces the Prismatic Beacon only around level 50–100; the 50% Prismatic Beacon talent is needed to reach it.
Golden Claw is the 15th original generator and the level 7 ones start at the 16th, so upgrade row 11 may come before the level 7 generator row; unverified until checked in game.

Early on, max an upgrade row's upgrades before moving on. After 0.320.0 you are mostly forced to buy the sand-generator side upgrades, and old upgrades costing e50 become affordable; Piwu holds the timeline reset to take upgrades 11 and 12 together. A timeline reset also resets upgrades. Timeline engine gains matter most.
Reset as soon as the Timeline opens and spend the first 10 infinity on three upgrades.
Once open, Rifts outpace engine gains.
Generator Speed first; until Hourglass level 3 it is the only gem upgrade that does anything. Then Awakening Amplifier, Timeline Engine Speed, Extra Rift Worker, following the Gems tiers.
The Bandiff card multiplies sand generation and the Beetleman card the timeline engine.
Time-skip hourglass items cannot be used in Act 3 until you have beaten its final boss (not yet in the game).
EvitaniaOnlineDB lists sand for levels 2–8 as 1e9, 1e15, 1e24, 1e36, 1e51, 1e74 and 1e120. Piwu's guide gives 100B and 100Qa for levels 2 and 3, so check the in-game figure.
Level 4 is the last cheap step: level 5 costs twelve orders of magnitude more. Go past 4 only with spare sand.

A time-skip hourglass advances only the active character: combat, mining, woodcutting and ash per kill. It does not advance other characters, the Smeltery, Bonfire ash from fuel, the pet egg or curio coins. Boss chests contain one 10% of the time. The 24-hour shop time-skip adds no Hourglass sand (player report).

From levels 12 and 16 the Hourglass talents also cost Act 3 wood and ore: about 280K wood and 550K ore to reach level 70 (a 700% bonus). Buy diamond upgrades top to bottom, left to right. Take talents 12 and 16 only once you hold the wood and ore (2026-07-20). The last Generator Speed talent can be skipped (2026-08-08). The second sand rift is weak next to timeline gains (2026-10-30). From level 7 focus on Echoes until the Golden dragon (2026-11-02). The level 7 unlock is the small bar under the hourglass (2026-11-16). The talent order after level 7 is posted only as screenshots, in the talents thread this row cites.

Rebirth is the 9th Hourglass slot, which the FAQ calls the white dragon though it is no dragon of the Dragons row. It rolls one Timeline Output or Sand item every 2 hours per EvitaniaOnlineDB, or one token an hour per the FAQ, with tokens building up offline; both unverified until checked in game. 3 items merge into 1 of the next level (5 into 2 with the upgrade). A sand tile gives about +1.02% sand and a timeline engine output tile about +1.01%. Its 5x5 grid starts with 3x3 open; the rest unlocks with cells in the Eternity tree. Secret Knowledge has up to 6 pages of up to 6 slots, and only the active page counts.

Five dragons: Red (sand income), Blue (timeline engine), Green (upgrade time), Golden (1.2e10 Echoes; strengthens the other three) and Black (5.1e19 Echoes). Every 25 dragon levels is a x2 milestone. Train a Red or Blue milestone as soon as it takes no longer than the next Green one, else train Green; rough pacing is Red at about Green / 2 + 25, and Blue 25 at Green 250, 50 at 550 and 75 at about 850. The Golden dragon is a big speed-up, and the planner's Solo level mode suits active play. Dragon Milestones is a gem-shop item; since 0.323.2 the Black Dragon gets no milestones.
A Time Echo level costs about 1e74 x 1.46^level sand (level 30 about 5.8e78), and the echo button works like MAX on generators. zoofy's calculator compares echoes against upgrades.
